Analysis of F004:

- Duplicate pair: INV_ID 505 (journal 1846, status P) and INV_ID 801 (journal 2484, status O). Same vendor, same invoice number after normalisation, same date and amount.
- Keep rule: keep the paid copy, which is 505. Void 801.
- Journal to reverse: 2484, the journal that recorded the voided copy 801. Reverse each of its lines (swap DR and CR) in an open period, with corrects_jrnl_no = 2484.
- Journal 2484 lines: 5200 DR 4637.81; 5400 DR 18729.93; 2000 CR 23367.74. Reversal: 5200 CR 4637.81; 5400 CR 18729.93; 2000 DR 23367.74.
- Open period: 11 (20241101 to 20241130). All three accounts (5200, 5400, 2000) are active.
- Status change: APINVH 801 to V. No other invoice changes.

Reversal balances: CR 23367.74 equals DR 23367.74.

arguments.reasoning: F004 is a confirmed duplicate of V0015-18723-505. INV_ID 505 (journal 1846) is paid (P), so it is kept. INV_ID 801 (journal 2484) is open (O), a duplicate entered later, so it is voided with a single status change to V. Journal 2484 recorded the voided copy, so every line is reversed (DR and CR swapped) in open period 11, referencing corrects_jrnl_no 2484. The reversal nets journal 2484 to zero and balances (CR 23367.74 = DR 23367.74). Accounts 5200, 5400 and 2000 are active. Journal 1846 and invoice 505 are not changed.
